title: Elon Musk appears to signal the end of the road for Cybertruck

claims.claim: Tesla, gelecek yıl Teksas fabrikasındaki Cybertruck üretimini sonlandıracak.

evidence.quote: Tesla will wind down production of its Cybertruck vehicles at its Texas factory next year, Elon Musk says.

claims.claim: Cybertruck, gecikmelerin ardından 2023 yılında piyasaya sürüldü.

evidence.quote: was beset by delays before being launched in 2023
With its distinctive angular looks, the Cybertruck attracted diehard fans, but was beset by delays before being launched in 2023 and has had disappointing sales numbers since.

claims.claim: Elon Musk, 2019 yılında geliştirme aşamasındayken Cybertruck'ın 146.000 sipariş aldığını söyledi.

evidence.quote: Despite the gaffe, the Cybertruck ended up receiving a 146,000 orders, Musk said in 2019, while it was still in development.

claims.claim: 2025 yılındaki bir geri çağırma, trim parçasının düşme riski nedeniyle 46.000'den fazla Cybertruck'ı etkiledi.

evidence.quote: Several recalls - including in 2025 affecting more than 46,000 Cybertrucks over concerns part of its trim could fall off - would not have helped.

claims.claim: Cybertruck'ın tüm özelliklere sahip versiyonu 61,000 dolardan satışa sunuldu.

evidence.quote: "We need to make it at a price that people can afford," Musk told Wall Street analysts that year - which ended up being $61,000 (then Â£48,000) for all the "bells and whistles".

claims.claim: 2026 yılında Cyberbeast modelinin fiyatı 102,000 dolar olarak belirlendi.

evidence.quote: In 2026, the so-called "Cyberbeast" model comes in at $102,000.

claims.claim: Projenin baş mühendisi Wes Morrill, X üzerinden aracın üretimden kaldırıldığını ima etti.

evidence.quote: But the project's lead engineer, Wes Morrill, appeared to suggest the vehicle was being discontinued, writing on X: "Cybertruck was an incredible technology development platform and lives on through Cybercab."
